defect: One campaign follow-on request was simultaneously routed through the superior-command decision/delivery lifecycle and a generic Qin Bureau operational-briefing support host. The superior order is the authoritative response path; the shadow support route could later surface a stale duplicate briefing.
scope_rule: Removes only the redundant pending shadow host/event and refreshes scheduler coverage at the same world time. It does not alter campaign revision, world time, formations, locations, manpower, equipment, injuries, current completed order, or the already-issued superior follow-on order.
